comment: GitHub #150, Kiln clients: the two screens that decide whether a respec is sent count the respec item with the game's UI count stations/client.UiAvailableCount(item, the local player's UI inventory mirror, the published Magic-chest map), the item from G38UiPlayData +0x44b238 (respec/client.ui.item, written by player_ui from its config), and send nothing when it is short. (1) The skill node details on the respec skill tree (HudScreen.SkillTreeRespec, C 0xcb7890): count >= the node's cost (its record +0x1c, r14d) offers the unlearn action (C 0xd91830 with action 2), which the tree's action handler (C 0xd4fc80) turns into UI command 0x4f (UnlearnSkillEvent); respec/client.NodeCountRet is that count's return. (2) The Flame Altar's reskill dialog (HudScreen.AltarReskill, C 0xc7ece0): met = count >= G38UiPlayData +0x44b23c (respec/client.ui.cost, the points spent) enables its button, whose confirmation sends UI command 0x4e with skill 0 (resetAllSkills); respec/client.AltarCountRet is that count's return. (3) The respec skill tree's own Rune row (C 0xcb9730) shows the count only: respec/client.HeaderCountRet, display only, not one of crafting.respec_sources' symbols. Client 26430625 (5d9ef2f1) only. docs/re/respec.md.

respec/client.NodeCountRet.comment: The skill node details: movzx r14d,word [rax+0x1c] (the node's cost); call the local player's UI inventory mirror; mov r12,[rsp+0x50] (G38UiPlayData); lea r8,[rbx+0x2000] (the published stock map); mov ecx,[r12+respec/client.ui.item]; call stations/client.UiAvailableCount; mov esi,eax (the count); ... cmp esi,r14d; jae (the unlearn is offered). The return address; kiln-items' mid hook there reads eax, r14d and r12, which the literal bytes pin. Client 26430625 0xcb7e98

respec/client.AltarCountRet.comment: The Flame Altar's reskill dialog: the loop to the local player's UI inventory mirror (G38UiPlayData's player list +0x3060, stride 0x8f70); mov ecx,[rdi+respec/client.ui.item]; mov r8,r9 (the published stock map); call stations/client.UiAvailableCount; mov ecx,[rdi+respec/client.ui.cost]; cmp eax,ecx; mov [rbp+0x58],ecx; setae [rbp+0x60] (met: the button is enabled with a cost). The return address; kiln-items' mid hook there reads eax and rdi, which the literal bytes pin. Client 26430625 0xc7eeb4

respec/client.HeaderCountRet.comment: The respec skill tree's Rune row (C 0xcb9730, its respec mode): the same loop to the player's mirror; mov ecx,[rbx+respec/client.ui.item]; call stations/client.UiAvailableCount; lea rcx,[rbp-0x70]; mov [rbp-0x48],eax (the count the row shows). Display only. The return address; kiln-items' mid hook there reads eax and rbx. Client 26430625 0xcb9cb4

respec/client.ui.item.comment: G38UiPlayData's respec item (player_ui writes it from its config: C 0x2b9763): 0x44b238

respec/client.ui.cost.comment: G38UiPlayData's respec cost, the points spent (player_ui writes it: C 0x2b98df): 0x44b23c
